answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities: each identity must burn a sunk fee to trade. An applicant burns 60 coins, twice its 30-day reward, and gets a violet badge. Peers check the badge before accepting work; unpaid identities earn nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 coins, exceeding any split reward. An honest agent pays once, tends one ember, and keeps undiluted rewards. A yarrow seller pays the same fee.
